Tuchel's 26-man squad blends established tournament veterans with a younger generation expected to shape England's future.Goalkeepers: Jordan Pickford, Dean Henderson, James TraffordDefenders: Reece James, Tino Livramento, Marc Guéhi, Ezri Konsa, John Stones, Jarell Quansah, Nico O’Reilly, Dan Burn, Djed SpenceMidfielders: Declan Rice, Elliot Anderson, Jude Bellingham, Jordan Henderson, Morgan Rogers, Kobbie Mainoo, Eberechi EzeForwards: Harry Kane, Ivan Toney, Ollie Watkins, Bukayo Saka, Noni Madueke, Marcus Rashford, Anthony GordonThe selection reflects Tuchel's preference for balance rather than reputation alone. Experienced leaders such as Kane, Pickford and Stones remain central figures, while younger names including Mainoo, Rogers and Quansah provide energy and versatility. It is a squad built with knockout football in mind, something Tuchel has developed a reputation for throughout his coaching career.
[...]
His 2024-25 Bundesliga season was extraordinary, and arriving at this World Cup, he is in the form of his life. Jude Bellingham was the heartbeat of England's run to the Euro 2024 final, and at 22, he is doing it all over again at Real Madrid. His ability to arrive late, find pockets, and produce in big moments makes him irreplaceable in this setup.Declan Rice anchors the midfield. His season at Arsenal, who have won the Premier League title, has been among the best of any defensive midfielder in Europe. Up front, Bukayo Saka has been electric, and alongside Kane, gives England a front combination that few sides can match.Marc Guehi, who moved to Manchester City in January and adapted immediately under Pep Guardiola, is expected to be Tuchel's first-choice centre-back. At the back, he brings calm and leadership. Jordan Pickford, meanwhile, remains England's undisputed number one, with his tournament experience and consistent shot-stopping locking him into the starting XI.
[...]
## Predicted England starting XI for World Cup 2026
[...]
Tuchel is a tactically adaptable manager. He is unlikely to lock into one shape and stick to it regardless, but his likely base formation is a 4-2-3-1.Pickford starts in goal. Reece James and Nico O'Reilly are expected at right-back and left-back respectively. Guehi and Konsa form the central defensive pairing. Rice and Elliot Anderson sit in the double pivot, with Bellingham operating as the number 10. Saka and Rashford provide the width, and Kane leads as the lone striker.Predicted XI (4-2-3-1): Pickford; James, Guehi, Konsa, O'Reilly; Rice, Anderson; Saka, Bellingham, Rashford; Kane

results.title: Netherlands World Cup 2026 squad: Full list, predicted lineup, depth chart, latest news - Sports Mole
highlights:
## Netherlands World Cup 2026 predicted XI
[...]
Netherlands were handed a major blow when Xavi Simons - a potential starter in the final third - was ruled out of the tournament with a serious knee injury.
[...]
Jurrien Timber has also since been ruled out with a groin injury, with Lutsharel Geertruida brought in as his replacement.
[...]
With Koeman light on central creative players in this team, it leaves Manchester City's Tijjani Reijnders in line to feature as a number 10, with Frenkie de Jong back fit to return in midfield after his absence during the March international break.
[...]
Donyell Malen's form for Roma could secure him the number nine role, potentially leaving who to choose on the right flank as Koeman's only attacking dilemma. Noa Lang may get the nod on that front.
[...]
Netherlands are blessed with an array of world-class defenders, yet a back four of Denzel Dumfries, Virgil van Dijk, Jan Paul van Hecke and Micky van de Ven feels set in stone.
[...]
Netherlands World Cup 2026 predicted XI: Verbruggen, Dumfries, Van Dijk, Van Hecke, Van de Ven; De Jong, Gravenberch; Lang, Reijnders, Gakpo; Malen
